title: The Shape of a Sphere
subtitle: A gentle illustrated guide to the Poincaré theorem
status: Solved classical theorem; archival reconstruction; no new-proof claim
claim_boundary: Illustrated, source-normalized exposition of the Hamilton–Perelman route. The analytic Ricci-flow and manifold-level topology theorems remain imported; the bounded formal certificate concerns finite event bookkeeping conditional on source-bound event relations.
